Composer API - Object Properties

  • Main Page



  • Modules

ComposerAPIDocumentObjectProp

Properties are used in PropertyMap (CLitPropertyMap) and PropertySet (CLitPropertySet) objects and are described in XML format. Change properties using SetPropertyMap() and SetPropertySet() methods.
Property Name Description Type Limits or Choices XML Example
Actor.Alpha Sets the actor transparency level. int [0,255] 
<Actor.Alpha Value="100"/>
Actor.Color Sets the actor color using RGB color components. int [0,255] 
<Actor.Color R="255" G="120" B="2"/>
Actor.Emission Sets the actor light emission intensity. float [0,1] 
<Actor.Emission Value="0.05"/>
Actor.Env.Effect Sets the actor material type. int

0:None
1:Chromic
2:Metal
3:Metal brushed
4:Plastic
5:Glass
6:Glass plastic
7:Chromic with color
8: Gold
9: Aluminum
10: Satin

 
<Actor.Env.Effect Value="3"/>
Actor.GeometryType Sets the actor geometry type. int

0: Undef
1: Volume
2: Surface

 
<Actor.GeometryType Value="0"/>
Actor.InertiaAxes Sets the actor inertia axis. int 
<Actor.InertiaAxes IsOk="1">
<Origin X="0" Y="0" Z="0" />
<VX X="1" Y="0" Z="0" />
<VY X="0" Y="1" Z="0" />
</Actor.InertiaAxes>
Actor.Location Sets the actor location and its pivot in the scene. int 
<Actor.Location VolatilePivot="0">
  <Frame IsOk="1">
    <Origin X="0" Y="0" Z="0" />
    <VX X="0" Y="0" Z="0" />
    <VY X="0" Y="0" Z="0" />
  </Frame>
  <Pivot IsOk="1">
    <Origin X="0" Y="0" Z="0" />
    <VX X="0" Y="0" Z="0" />
    <VY X="0" Y="0" Z="0" />
  </Pivot>
  <StartPivot IsOk="0" />
  <EndPivot IsOk="0" />
</Actor.Location>
Actor.Name Sets the actor name. string 
<Actor.Name Value="Body01"/>
Actor.Prop.Area Sets the actor area  (-1 when area information not available). float [-1,inf] 
<Actor.Prop.Area Value="102"/>
Actor.Prop.Volume Sets the actor volume (-1 when volume information not available). float [-1,inf] 
<Actor.Prop.Volume Value="-1"/>
Actor.Shininess Sets the actor shininess level. int [0,128] 
<Actor.Shininess Value="100"/>
Actor.ToolTip Sets the actor tooltip. string 
<Actor.ToolTip Value="This is Body01"/>
Billboard Sets the "always stay in front" state of a panel. int

0: None
1: XYZ
2: Up

 
<Billboard Value="2"/>
CuttingPlane.AutoFlip Applies auto-flip to the cutting plane. Boolean [0,1] 
<CuttingPlane.AutoFlip Value="1"/>
CuttingPlane.Axis Sets the cutting plane axis.
 int 0: User
1: X
2: Y
3: Z
 
<CuttingPlane.Axis Value="1"/>
CuttingPlane.Capping Applies capping to cut actors. Boolean [0,1] 
<CuttingPlane.Capping Value="1"/>
CuttingPlane.CuttingLineShow Draws the cutting line. Boolean [0,1] 
<CuttingPlane.CuttingLineShow Value="1"/>
CuttingPlane.CuttingLineTickness Sets the thickness of the cutting line. int [0,8] 
<CuttingPlane.CuttingLineTickness Value="2"/>
CuttingPlane.CuttingLineColorChange Sets the cutting line color. int [0,255] 
<CuttingPlane.CuttingLineColor R="255" G="0" B="255"/>
CuttingPlane.Enable Enables the cutting plane. Boolean [0,1] 
<CuttingPlane.Enable Value="1"/>
CuttingPlane.Offset Sets the cutting plane position along its axis. int [0,100] 
<CuttingPlane.Offset Value="35"/>
CuttingPlane.SpaceBackAlpha Sets the transparency level of actors located behind the cutting plane. int [0,255] 
<CuttingPlane.SpaceBackAlpha Value="255"/>
CuttingPlane.SpaceFrontAlpha Sets the transparency level of actors located in front of the cutting plane. int [0,255] 
<CuttingPlane.SpaceFrontAlpha Value="100"/>
Digger.COIOn Activates the Digger center of interest tool. Boolean [0,1] 
<Digger.COIOn Value="0"/>
Digger.COIPos Sets the Digger center of interest position. float 
<Digger.COIPos X="0" Y="0" Z="0" />
Digger.Depth Sets the depth of the current Digger rendering mode. float [0,1] 
<Digger.Depth Value="0.5">
Digger.LightOn Activates the Digger light tool.
 Boolean [0,1] 
<Digger.LightOn Value="0"/>
Digger.LightPos Sets the position of the light used inside the Digger tool. float [-1,1] 
<Digger.LightPos X="-1" Y="0" Z="0" />
Digger.Lock Locks Digger depth view. Boolean [0,1] 
<Digger.Lock Value="1"/>
Digger.Position Sets the Digger location. float [0,inf[ 
<Digger.Position X="0,2940415" Y="0,7071428" Z="0" />
Digger.Radius Sets the Digger size. float [0,inf[ 
<Digger.Radius Value="210"/>
Digger.Renderer Sets the rendering mode of Digger. int

0: Onion skin
1: X-ray
2: Cutting Plane
3: Zoom

 
<Digger.Renderer Value="2"/>
Inspector.Enabled Enables Digger. Boolean [0,1] 
<Inspector.Enabled Value="0"/>
Link Launches or opens a file or a feature (marker, view, ...). string 
<Link Value="marker://marker1"/>
Navigator.Camera.Location Sets the camera position in the scene. int

  <Frame IsOk="1">
    <Origin X="18858,6" Y="-249,4097" Z="83,69646" />
    <VX X="-0,7311893" Y="-0,6744974" Z="-0,1020562" />
    <VY X="0,2792878" Y="-0,4324775" Z="0,857299" />
  </Frame>
  <Pivot IsOk="1">
    <Origin X="18993,41" Y="-379,0098" Z="-25,59928" />
    <VX X="-0,7311893" Y="-0,6744974" Z="-0,1020562" />
    <VY X="0,2792878" Y="-0,4324775" Z="0,857299" />
  </Pivot>
  <StartPivot IsOk="0" />
  <EndPivot IsOk="0" />
</Navigator.Camera.Location>
Navigator.Camera.Proj.Persp Enables orthogonal or perspective projection mode. Boolean [0,1] 
<Navigator.Camera.Proj.Persp Value="1"/>
Navigator.Camera.Vertical Sets the vertical axis of the scene. int

0: X
1: Y
2: Z
3: X<0
4: Y<0
5: Z<0

 
<Navigator.Camera.Vertical Value="2"/>
Panel.Height Sets the height of a panel. int 
<Panel.Height="100/>
Panel.Width Sets the width of a panel. int 
<Panel.Width="100"/>
Text.AutoShow Shows the text when the mouse is over it, even if its visibility state is "hidden". Boolean [0,1] 
<Text.AutoShow Value="0"/>
Text.Bk Sets the text background color. float [0,255] 
<Text.Bk R="255" G="0" B="100"/>
Text.DrawMPStyle Draws a line for each actor linked to a text. Boolean [0,1] 
<Text.FrawMPStyle Value="0"/>
Text.Font Sets the font of the text. int, string 
<Text.Font CharSet="0" ClipPrecision="0" 
Escapement="0" FaceName="Arial" Height="-11"/>
Text.Foreground.Color Sets the text color. float [0,255] 
<Text.Foreground.Color R="255" G="0" B="100"/>
Text.Position Sets the position of the text. float 
<Text.Position X="12,8274" Y="-30,14723" Z="61,7976" />
Text.PostString Sets the string added at the end of the text. string 
<Text.PostString Value="Test String"/>
Text.ShowInertiaAxes Shows inertia axes of actors linked to text. Boolean [0,1] 
<Text.ShowInertiaAxes Value="1"/>
Text.StayOnTop Makes the text always visible. Boolean [0,1] 
<Text.StayOnTop Value="1"/>
Text.String Sets the text string. string 
<Text.String Value="Test String"/>
Texture.Blending.Mode Activates texture blending. Boolean [0,1] 
<Texture.Blending.Mode Value="1"/>
Texture.Frame.Gen Sets the texture projection frame. int

0: Planar
1: Cylindrical
2: Spherical

 
<Texture.Frame.Gen ProjectionMode="2">
  <Frame IsOk="1">
    <Origin X="-114,9057" Y="106,0566" Z="278,2914" />
    <VX X="0" Y="-0,0126573" Z="0,9999199" />
    <VY X="1" Y="4,168726E-06" Z="5,276904E-08" />
  </Frame>
</Texture.Frame.Gen>
Texture.Image.Fill.Mode Specifies the way the image is applied on a panel. int

0: No deformation
1: Stretch
2: Repeat

 
<Texture.Image.Fill.Mode Value="1"/>
Texture.Map.Path Applies the specified image texture to an actor. string 
<Texture.Map.Path Value="C:\maps\metal1.JPG"/>
Texture.Transparency Activates texture transparency. Boolean [0,1] 
<Texture.Transparency Value="0"/>
Texture.UV.Ratio Sets the aspect ratio of the map. int [0,100] 
<Texture.UV.Ratio Value="43"/>
Texture.UV.Scale Sets how many times the map is repeated on an actor. int [0,100] 
<Texture.UV.Scale Value="59"/>
Viewport.BkAlpha Sets the opacity of the viewport. This property is useful for Motion Blur. int [0,255] 
<Viewport.BkAlpha Value="120"/>
Viewport.BkColor Sets the viewport background color using RGB color components. int [0,255] 
<Viewport.BkColor R="100" G="120" B="0"/>
Viewport.BkFootColor Sets the foot viewport background color if gradient is activated using RGB color components. int [0,255] 
<Viewport.BkFootColor R="0" G="255" B="30"/>
Viewport.Bk.ImgeFillMode Sets the image fill mode of the viewport background image. int

0: No deformation
1:Stretch
2: Environment

 
<Viewport.Bk.ImageFillMode Value="2"/>
Viewport.Camera.Fov Sets the camera perspective angle. int [0,255] 
<Viewport.Camera.Fov Value="255"/>
Viewport.Lights.Diffuse Sets diffuse light intensity. int [0,255] 
<Viewport.Ligths.Diffuse Value="126"/>
Viewport.Lights.Specular Sets specular light intensity. int [0,255] 
<Viewport.Lights.Specular Value="248"/>
Viewport.MotionBlur Activates motion blur. Boolean [0,1] 
<Viewport.Motionblur Value="0"/>
Viewport.Render.BackCulling Draws back faces. Boolean [0,1] 
<Viewport.Render.BackCulling Value="1"/>
Viewport.Render.GroundGrid Displays the grid on the ground. Boolean [0,1] 
<Viewport.Render.GroundGrid Value="0"/>
Viewport.Render.GroundShadows Displays shadows on the ground. Boolean [0,1] 
<Viewport.Render.GroundShadows Value="1"/>
Viewport.Render.GroundShadowsNbPass Decides how many images are computed to display soft shadows. int [0,16] 
<Viewport.Render.GroundShadowsNbPass Value="8"/>
Viewport.Render.Mode Sets the viewport rendering mode.
 int

0: Smooth
1: Smooth and outlines
2: Technical
3: Flat Technical
4: Silhouette
5: Flat
6: WireFrame
7: Points

 
<Viewport.Render.Mode Value="3"/>
